verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָה לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְךָ֥ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’el- dā·wîḏ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh lê·mōr hin·nêh ‘aṣ·mə·ḵā ū·ḇə·śā·rə·ḵā ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said Here we are your own flesh and blood
verses.literalPt: Congregou-se todo o Israel com Davi, em Hebrom, dizendo: Nós somos teus ossos e tua carne.

verses.original: גַּם־ תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּהְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא וְהַמֵּבִ֖יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- tə·mō·wl gam- šil·šō·wm gam bih·yō·wṯ šā·’ūl me·leḵ ’at·tāh ham·mō·w·ṣî wə·ham·mê·ḇî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·ḵā ’at·tāh ṯir·‘eh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh nā·ḡîḏ ‘al ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Even . . . . . . in times past . . . while Saul was king you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back And the LORD your God said You will shepherd My people Israel and you will be ruler over them . . .
verses.literalPt: Já dantes, ainda quando Saul era rei, eras tu o que fazias sair e entrar a Israel; e Jeová, teu Deus, te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo de Israel e serás o seu condutor.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh way·yiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem dā·wîḏ bə·rîṯ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yim·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- šə·mū·’êl
verses.literal: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron where David made a covenant with them before the LORD And they anointed him king over Israel according to the word of the LORD through Samuel
verses.literalPt: Todos os anciãos de Israel vieram ter com o rei em Hebrom, onde Davi fez aliança com eles diante de Jeová; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra de Jeová por intermédio de Samuel.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְשָׁם֙ הַיְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wîḏ wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl yə·rū·šā·lim hî yə·ḇūs wə·šām hay·ḇū·sî yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is Jebus) where the Jebusites inhabited the land
verses.literalPt: Partiu Davi com todo o Israel para Jerusalém ( que é Jebus); e estavam ali os jebuseus, habitantes da terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְדָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū yō·šə·ḇê yə·ḇūs lə·ḏā·wîḏ lō ṯā·ḇō·w hên·nāh way·yil·kōḏ dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- mə·ṣu·ḏaṯ ṣî·yō·wn hî ‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: The people of Jebus said to David You will never get in here Nevertheless , David captured the fortress of Zion that is the City of David
verses.literalPt: Disseram os habitantes de Jebus a Davi: Não entrarás aqui. Todavia, Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião, que é a Cidade de Davi.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כָּל־ מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּרִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְרֹ֖אשׁ וּלְשָׂ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַל בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה וַיְהִ֥י לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ kāl- mak·kêh yə·ḇū·sî bā·ri·šō·w·nāh yih·yeh lə·rōš ū·lə·śār way·ya·‘al bā·ri·šō·w·nāh yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh way·hî lə·rōš
verses.literal: Now David had said Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first and he became the chief
verses.literalPt: Davi disse: Aquele que primeiro ferir os jebuseus será chefe e capitão. Subiu primeiro Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e foi feito chefe.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּמְצָ֑ד עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ dā·wîḏ bam·ṣāḏ ‘al- kên qā·rə·’ū- lōw ‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: So David took up residence in the fortress that is why . . . it was called the City of David
verses.literalPt: Davi habitou na fortaleza; por isso, se lhe chamou a Cidade de Davi.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן הָעִיר֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וְעַד־ הַסָּבִ֑יב וְיוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת־ שְׁאָ֥ר הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen hā·‘îr mis·sā·ḇîḇ min- ham·mil·lō·w wə·‘aḏ- has·sā·ḇîḇ wə·yō·w·’āḇ yə·ḥay·yeh ’eṯ- šə·’ār hā·‘îr
verses.literal: He built up the city around it from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall while Joab restored the rest of the city
verses.literalPt: Edificou a cidade ao redor, desde Milo ao redor; e Joabe reparou o resto da cidade.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ dā·wîḏ hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And David became greater and greater for the LORD of Hosts was with him
verses.literalPt: Davi ia tornando-se cada vez mais forte, porque Jeová dos Exércitos era com ele.

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַגִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֔יד הַמִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧וֹ בְמַלְכוּת֛וֹ עִם־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִיכ֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh rā·šê hag·gib·bō·w·rîm ’ă·šer lə·ḏā·wîḏ ham·miṯ·ḥaz·zə·qîm ‘im·mōw ḇə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw ‘im- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ham·lî·ḵōw kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men who together with all Israel bolstered and strengthened his kingdom according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, estes são os principais dos homens poderosos que Davi tinha, os quais, juntamente com todo o Israel, se mostraram fortes com ele no seu reino, para o fazerem rei, segundo a palavra de Jeová sobre Israel.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑יד יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁים הֽוּא־ עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֛וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mis·par hag·gib·bō·rîm ’ă·šer lə·ḏā·wîḏ yā·šā·ḇə·‘ām ben- ḥaḵ·mō·w·nî rōš haš·šə·lō·šīm hū- ‘ō·w·rêr ’eṯ- ḥă·nî·ṯōw ‘al- šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl bə·p̄a·‘am ’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: This is the list of David’s mighty men Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers he wielded his spear against three hundred men whom he killed at one time
verses.literalPt: Este é o número dos homens poderosos que Davi tinha: Jasobeão, filho dum hacmonita, chefe dos trinta; este levantou a sua lança sobre trezentos, que matou duma só vez.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ הָאֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rāw ’el·‘ā·zār ben- dō·w·ḏōw hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî hū biš·lō·wō·šāh hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite . . . one of the three mighty men
verses.literalPt: Depois dele, Eleazar, filho de Dodô, aoíta, que era um dos três homens poderosos.

verses.original: הֽוּא־ הָיָ֨ה עִם־ דָּוִ֜יד בַּפַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְהַפְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hū- hā·yāh ‘im- dā·wîḏ bap·pas dam·mîm wə·hap·pə·liš·tîm ne·’ĕs·p̄ū- šå̄m lam·mil·ḥā·māh wat·tə·hî ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh mə·lê·’āh śə·‘ō·w·rîm wə·hā·‘ām nā·sū mip·pə·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle At a place with a field full of barley the troops fled from the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Este se achou com Davi em Pas-Damim, onde se ajuntaram os filisteus a dar batalha, num lugar em que havia um pedaço de campo cheio de cevada; o povo fugiu de diante dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּיל֔וּהָ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- ha·ḥel·qāh way·yaṣ·ṣî·lū·hā way·yak·kū ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh tə·šū·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it They struck down the Philistines and the LORD brought about a great victory
verses.literalPt: Tiveram-se no meio do campo, e defenderam-no, e mataram aos filisteus; e Jeová os salvou com uma grande vitória.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל־ הַצֻּר֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔יד אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū šə·lō·wō·šāh min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šîm rōš ‘al- haṣ·ṣur ’el- dā·wîḏ ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ‘ă·ḏul·lām ū·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm ḥō·nāh bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: Três dos trinta chefes desceram à penha a ter com Davi e entraram na caverna de Adulão; e o exército dos filisteus estava acampado no vale de Refaim.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּנְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּבֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wîḏ ’āz bam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh ū·nə·ṣîḇ pə·liš·tîm ’āz bə·ḇêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: At that time David was in the stronghold and the garrison of the Philistines . . . was at Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Davi estava nesse lugar forte, e a guarnição estava, então, em Belém.

verses.original: וַיִּתְאָו דָּוִ֖יד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ʾå̄w dā·wîḏ way·yō·mar mî yaš·qê·nî ma·yim mib·bō·wr bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ă·šer baš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: David longed for water and said Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Davi sentiu um grande desejo e disse: Quem me dera beber a água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta!

verses.original: וַיִּבְקְע֨וּ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִבּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑יד וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·qə·‘ū haš·šə·lō·šāh bə·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yiš·’ă·ḇū- ma·yim mib·bō·wr bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ă·šer baš·ša·‘ar way·yiś·’ū way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’el- dā·wîḏ wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh ḏā·wîḏ liš·tō·w·ṯām way·nas·sêḵ ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp drew water from the well at the gate . . . of Bethlehem and brought it back to David But he refused . . . to drink it instead , he poured it out to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os três romperam pelo arraial dos filisteus, e tiraram água do poço de Belém, que estava junto à porta, tomaram dela, e trouxeram a Davi; Davi, porém, não a quis beber, mas a derramou em libação a Jeová

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י מֵאֱלֹהַ֜י מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את הֲדַ֣ם הָאֲנָשִׁים֩ הָאֵ֨לֶּה אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה בְנַפְשׁוֹתָם֙ כִּ֣י בְנַפְשׁוֹתָ֣ם הֱבִיא֔וּם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥā·lî·lāh lî mê·’ĕ·lō·hay mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ zōṯ hă·ḏam hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh ’eš·teh ḇə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯām kî ḇə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯām hĕ·ḇî·’ūm wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh liš·tō·w·ṯām ’êl·leh ‘ā·śū šə·lō·šeṯ hag·gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: saying Far be it from me my God to do this How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives David refused . . . to drink it Such were the exploits of the three mighty men
verses.literalPt: e disse: Não permita meu Deus que eu faça isso. Beberei eu o sangue destes homens que expuseram as suas vidas? Pois, com perigo das suas vidas, a trouxeram. Portanto, não a quis beber. Isto fizeram os três homens poderosos.

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי־ יוֹאָ֗ב ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלֹא שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šay ’ă·ḥî- yō·w·’āḇ hū hā·yāh rōš haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh wə·hū ‘ō·w·rêr ’eṯ- ḥă·nî·ṯōw ‘al- šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl wə·lō šêm baš·šə·lō·wō·šāh
verses.literal: Now Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three . . . and he wielded his spear against three hundred men killed them and won a name along with the Three
verses.literalPt: Abisai, irmão de Joabe, era chefe dos três; porque levantou a sua lança contra trezentos, e os matou, e teve nome entre os três.

verses.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה בַשְּׁנַ֙יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹֽא־ בָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh ḇaš·šə·na·yim niḵ·bāḏ way·hî lā·hem lə·śār wə·‘aḏ- haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh lō- ḇā
verses.literal: He was doubly honored above the Three and he became their commander . . . even though he was not included among the Three
verses.literalPt: Ele foi mais ilustre do que os três da segunda série e foi feito o seu capitão; todavia, não igualava aos primeiros três.

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־ אִֽישׁ־ חַ֛יִל רַב־ פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽן־ קַבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִ֛י בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבּ֖וֹר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nā·yāh ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- ’îš- ḥa·yil raḇ- pə·‘ā·lîm min- qaḇ·ṣə·’êl hū hik·kāh ’êṯ šə·nê ’ă·rî·’êl mō·w·’āḇ wə·hū yā·raḏ wə·hik·kāh ’eṯ- hā·’ă·rî bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·bō·wr bə·yō·wm haš·šā·leḡ
verses.literal: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel a man of many exploits He struck down two champions of Moab and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion
verses.literalPt: Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho dum homem de Cabzeel, valente e célebre por grandes feitos, matou dois filhos de Ariel, de Moabe. Também desceu a uma cova, onde matou um leão em tempo de neve.

verses.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִכָּה֩ אֶת־ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַמִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה׀ חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּאַמָּ֗ה וּבְיַ֨ד הַמִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ כִּמְנ֣וֹר אֹרְגִ֔ים וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hik·kāh ’eṯ- hā·’îš ham·miṣ·rî ’îš mid·dāh ḥā·mêš bā·’am·māh ū·ḇə·yaḏ ham·miṣ·rî ḥă·nîṯ kim·nō·wr ’ō·rə·ḡîm way·yê·reḏ ’ê·lāw baš·šā·ḇeṭ way·yiḡ·zōl ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·nîṯ mî·yaḏ ham·miṣ·rî way·ya·har·ḡê·hū ba·ḥă·nî·ṯōw
verses.literal: He also struck down - an Egyptian a huge man five cubits tall Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand Benaiah went against him with a club snatched the spear from his hand and killed the Egyptian with his own spear
verses.literalPt: Matou a um egípcio, cuja estatura era de cinco cúbitos e que tinha na mão uma lança como órgão do tear de tecelão; desceu contra ele com uma vara, arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio e o matou com a sua mesma lança.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ‘ā·śāh bə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·lōw- šêm biš·lō·wō·šāh hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada who won a name along with the three mighty men
verses.literalPt: Essas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, e teve nome entre os três homens poderosos.

verses.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤וֹ נִכְבָּד֙ ה֔וּא וְאֶל־ הַשְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָ֑א וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖יד עַל־ מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šə·lō·wō·šîm hin·nōw niḵ·bāḏ hū wə·’el- haš·šə·lō·wō·šāh lō- ḇā way·śî·mê·hū ḏā·wîḏ ‘al- miš·ma‘·tōw
verses.literal: He was most honored among the Thirty . . . but he did not become one of the Three And David appointed him over his guard
verses.literalPt: Ele era mais ilustre do que os trinta, porém não igualava aos primeiros três. Davi o pôs sobre os da sua guarda.

verses.original: וְגִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַחֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ דּוֹד֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡib·bō·w·rê ha·ḥă·yā·lîm ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ’ă·ḥî yō·w·’āḇ ’el·ḥā·nān ben- dō·w·ḏōw mib·bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Now these were the mighty men . . . Asahel the brother of Joab Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Também os homens poderosos dos exércitos: Asael, irmão de Joabe, Elanã, filho de Dodô, de Belém;

verses.original: שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַהֲרוֹרִ֔י חֶ֖לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: šam·mō·wṯ ha·hă·rō·w·rî ḥe·leṣ hap·pə·lō·w·nî
verses.literal: Shammoth the Harorite Helez the Pelonite
verses.literalPt: Samote, harorita, Helez, pelonita;

verses.original: עִירָ֤א בֶן־ עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַתְּקוֹעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָעֲנְּתוֹתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘î·rā ḇen- ‘iq·qêš hat·tə·qō·w·‘î ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer hā·‘ăn·nə·ṯō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite Abiezer the Anathothite
verses.literalPt: Ira, filho de Iques, tecoíta, Abiezer, anatotita;

verses.original: סִבְּכַי֙ הַחֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י עִילַ֖י הָאֲחוֹחִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: sib·bə·ḵay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî ‘î·lay hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî
verses.literal: Sibbecai the Hushathite Ilai the Ahohite
verses.literalPt: Sibecai, husatita, Ilai, aoíta;

verses.original: מַהְרַי֙ הַנְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן־ בַּֽעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטוֹפָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: mah·ray han·nə·ṭō·p̄ā·ṯî ḥê·leḏ ben- ba·‘ă·nāh han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Maharai the Netophathite Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite
verses.literalPt: Maarai, netofatita, Helede, filho de Baaná, netofatita;

verses.original: אִיתַ֣י בֶּן־ רִיבַ֗י מִגִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ןס בְּנָיָ֖ה הַפִּרְעָתֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’î·ṯay ben- rî·ḇay mig·giḇ·‘aṯ bə·nê ḇin·yå̄·mi·ns bə·nā·yāh hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·nî
verses.literal: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites . . . Benaiah the Pirathonite
verses.literalPt: Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá, dos filhos de Benjamim, Benaia, piratonita;

verses.original: חוּרַי֙ מִנַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁס אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָעַרְבָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥū·ray min·na·ḥă·lê ḡå̄·ʿa·šs ’ă·ḇî·’êl hā·‘ar·ḇā·ṯî
verses.literal: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash Abiel the Arbathite
verses.literalPt: Hurai, das torrentes de Gaás, Abiel, arbatita;

verses.original: עַזְמָ֙וֶת֙ הַבַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַשַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘az·mā·weṯ hab·ba·ḥă·rū·mî ’el·yaḥ·bā haš·ša·‘al·ḇō·nî
verses.literal: Azmaveth the Baharumite Eliahba the Shaalbonite
verses.literalPt: Azmavete, baarumita, Eliaba, saalbonita;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַגִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן־ שָׁגֵ֖ה הַהֲרָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê hā·šêm hag·gi·zō·w·nî yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- šā·ḡêh ha·hă·rā·rî
verses.literal: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Hasém, gizonita, Jônatas, filho de Sage, hararita;

verses.original: אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן־ שָׂכָ֛ר הַהֲרָרִ֖י אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן־ אֽוּר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥî·’ām ben- śā·ḵār ha·hă·rā·rî ’ĕ·lî·p̄al ben- ’ūr
verses.literal: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite Eliphal son of Ur
verses.literalPt: Aião, filho de Sacar, hararita, Elifal, filho de Ur;

verses.original: חֵ֚פֶר הַמְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַפְּלֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·p̄er ham·mə·ḵê·rā·ṯî ’ă·ḥî·yāh hap·pə·lō·nî
verses.literal: Hepher the Mecherathite Ahijah the Pelonite
verses.literalPt: Héfer, mequeratita, Aías, pelonita;

verses.original: חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן־ אֶזְבָּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥeṣ·rōw hak·kar·mə·lî na·‘ă·ray ben- ’ez·bāy
verses.literal: Hezro the Carmelite Naarai son of Ezbai
verses.literalPt: Hezro, carmelita, Naarai, filho de Ezbai;

verses.original: יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן־ הַגְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’êl ’ă·ḥî nā·ṯān miḇ·ḥār ben- haḡ·rî
verses.literal: Joel the brother of Nathan Mibhar son of Hagri
verses.literalPt: Joel, irmão de Natã, Mibar, filho de Hagri;

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַבֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣe·leq hā·‘am·mō·w·nî naḥ·ray hab·bê·rō·ṯî nō·śê kə·lê yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh
verses.literal: Zelek the Ammonite Naharai the Beerothite the armor-bearer . . . of Joab son of Zeruiah
verses.literalPt: Zeleque, amonita, Naarai, berotita, escudeiro de Joabe, filho de Zeruia;

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘î·rā hay·yiṯ·rî gā·rêḇ hay·yiṯ·rî
verses.literal: Ira the Ithrite Gareb the Ithrite
verses.literalPt: Ira, itrita, Garebe, itrita;

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַחִתִּ֔י זָבָ֖ד בֶּן־ אַחְלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ū·rî·yāh ha·ḥit·tî zā·ḇāḏ ben- ’aḥ·lāy
verses.literal: Uriah the Hittite Zabad son of Ahlai
verses.literalPt: Urias, heteu, Zabade, filho de Alai;

verses.original: עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן־ שִׁיזָ֜א הָרֽאוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְעָלָ֥יו שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḏî·nā ḇen- šî·zā hā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî rōš lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî wə·‘ā·lāw šə·lō·wō·šîm
verses.literal: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite chief of the Reubenites and the thirty with him
verses.literalPt: Adina, filho de Siza, rubenita, chefe dos rubenitas, e, com ele, trinta;

verses.original: חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְיוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַמִּתְנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nān ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·yō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ham·miṯ·nî
verses.literal: Hanan son of Maacah Joshaphat the Mithnite
verses.literalPt: Hanã, filho de Maaca, e Josafá, mitenita;

verses.original: עֻזִיָּ֖א הָעֲשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י שָׁמָע֙ וִיעוּאֵל בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָעֲרֹעֵרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘u·zî·yā hā·‘ăš·tə·rā·ṯî šā·mā‘ wī·ʿū·ʾēl bə·nê ḥō·w·ṯām hā·‘ă·rō·‘ê·rî
verses.literal: Uzzia the Ashterathite Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite
verses.literalPt: Uzias, asteratita, Sama e Jeiel, filhos de Hotão, aroerita;

verses.original: יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן־ שִׁמְרִ֔י וְיֹחָ֥א אָחִ֖יו הַתִּיצִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏî·‘ă·’êl ben- šim·rî wə·yō·ḥā ’ā·ḥîw hat·tî·ṣî
verses.literal: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite
verses.literalPt: Jediael, filho de Sinri, e seu irmão Joá, tizita;

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽמַּחֲוִ֔ים וִירִיבַ֥י וְיוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם וְיִתְמָ֖ה הַמּוֹאָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·’êl ham·ma·ḥă·wîm wî·rî·ḇay wə·yō·wō·šaw·yāh bə·nê ’el·nā·‘am wə·yiṯ·māh ham·mō·w·’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: Eliel the Mahavite Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam Ithmah the Moabite
verses.literalPt: Eliel, maavita, e Jeribai e Josavias, filho de Elnão, e Itma, moabita;

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְעוֹבֵ֔ד וְיַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַמְּצֹבָיָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·’êl wə·‘ō·w·ḇêḏ wə·ya·‘ă·śî·’êl ham·mə·ṣō·ḇā·yāh
verses.literal: Eliel Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite
verses.literalPt: Eliel, Obede e Jaasiel, mezobaíta.
